data.name: Cold Response
data.detailed_description:
EVERY BULLET A RISK. EVERY ITEM A LIABILITY.

Survive a brutal, persistent and sometimes contaminated 100-player 400km^2 open world where the environment is as lethal as the players. In this high-stakes PvPvE landscape, there are no match timers, no artificial resets, and no safety nets. Your survival depends on tactical patience, physical preparation, and the literal integrity of your gear.

Vulnerable Physical Inventory

In most games, your backpack is a magic void. Here, every item is a physical object. Vests and carriers offer protection and storage, but they are subject to the same ballistics as your body.

  • Collateral Damage: If your carrier vest is hit, the items inside, from fragile medical vials to volatile explosives, can be destroyed or detonate on your chest.

  • Weight of the World: Carrying capacity and item weight directly impact your stamina and calorie consumption. Every piece of loot is a trade-off between power and exhaustion.

Tactical Ballistics & Physiological Trauma

Combat is defined by realistic physics, including bullet trajectory, gravity, and material penetration. We move beyond simple health bars to a complex physiological system:

  • Shock & Blood: Track your blood levels and shock value. Accumulated shock can render you unconscious in the middle of a firefight, while blood loss impairs vision and physical performance.

  • Manual Medical Intervention: Wounds don't heal themselves. You must manually manage your recovery, treating specific traumas to avoid debilitating infections that cause audible coughing or groaning, betraying your position to nearby threats.

The Scavenger’s Logic: 11 Functional Biomes

The world is logical. Loot spawns according to the history of the world, forcing you to plan your expeditions based on your immediate needs:

  • The Essentials: Scavenge Food, Civilian, and Agricultural zones to stay fueled.

  • The Foundation: Raid Industrial, Construction, and Hunting areas for tools and base-building materials.

  • The Frontline: Secure life-saving gear in Police, Firefighter, and Medic hubs.

  • The Endgame: Braving Military complexes and Contaminated zones is the only way to secure top-tier weaponry and specialized protection.

Player-Driven Economy & Territory

  • Safe Zone Hubs: Travel long distances to neutral social hubs to trade. While NPC vendors provide basics, the core economy is a player-to-player marketplace driven by real supply and demand.

  • Base Building: Establish a foothold using the Plotpole system to claim land. Build tiered shelters and workbenches, but be prepared, bases require regular upkeep to prevent decay, demanding active resource management.

Absolute Permanent Death

Death is final. When you die, you lose everything. Your body remains in the world, leaving your loot, and the gear that wasn't destroyed in the fight, available for anyone to scavenge. Stealth and preparation are not just playstyles; they are requirements for a long life.

Open-Source Modding & Persistence

Built on Unreal Engine 5 with AngelScript gameplay logic, the game is designed for community longevity.

Host Your Own: Deploy dedicated servers with custom rule sets.

Expand the Game: Utilize open-source core logic to create custom mods, assets, and unique gameplay loops for your community.

data.short_description: Explore and survive a war torn Sweden through the eyes of an unknown soldier, alone or with friends.

  • OS: Windows 10

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

  • Storage: 15 GB available space
